name: Lantern Helmet
lore: Wear: level-12 moving light. One coal/charcoal fuels 90 active seconds. Iron-level head protection; no night vision.

name: Clockwork Trackless Cart
lore: Use on clear ground to deploy. Ride and steer; 6.4 blocks/sec, one-block steps, no flight. Coal/charcoal: 45 driving seconds. Sneak-interact while empty to pack; fuel/health are retained.

name: Wayfinder Compass
lore: Sneak-use: save one waypoint. Use: bearing and distance in the same dimension. No teleportation or target detection.

name: Ariadne Trail Spool
lore: Use: toggle breadcrumb recording while held. Sneak-use: retrace the last 48 markers (4-block spacing). No teleportation; trail stays with the item.

name: Mason Builder Wand
lore: Use: place up to eight ordinary building blocks in a row beside the aimed face. Put building blocks in the next hotbar slot. Consumes every block; 3-second cooldown; no containers or redstone machinery.

name: Seedweaver Planter
lore: Use on farmland: plant a 3x3 area using wheat seeds, carrots, potatoes or beetroot seeds from the next hotbar slot. Consumes each planting; no growth boost. 5-second cooldown.

name: Autumn Harvest Sickle
lore: Use: harvest at most nine ripe crops in a 3x3 area. Replants only if you carry the matching seed/crop. Normal drops; no Fortune bonus or instant growth. 12-second cooldown.

name: Reclaimer Salvage Tool
lore: Use: choose an unenchanted vanilla iron tool/armor to destroy and recover at most half its remaining iron value. No god/forged gear, enchantments, diamonds or duplication.

name: Thermal Safety Lens
lore: Use: scan loaded blocks within eight blocks for the nearest lava hazard and show a direction/particle warning. No player, mob, chest or ore detection. 15-second cooldown.

name: Mason Survey Level
lore: Use: preview a square footprint and center line on the ground for eight seconds. Sneak-use: cycle 5/9/13-block widths. Measuring only; never places or breaks terrain.
